summary: Lion Group Holding Ltd. filed a Form 6-K attaching a press release that reaffirms its long-term holding of Hyperliquid (HYPE) tokens as part of its treasury management strategy. The company disclosed it holds 193,775 HYPE tokens, valued at approximately USD 11.9 million as of May 25, 2026, and has not sold any. The release discusses Hyperliquid's developments and ETF launches but does not involve any transaction, corporate action, or event that qualifies as a special situation. This is a routine update on treasury holdings, not triggering any special-situation category.
